entries.definition:
a.
1 (lb en of a vehicle) Not move, but not properly parked or berthed; (non-gloss: said also of the occupants of such a vehicle.)
2 (lb en more generally) In the state resulting from having stopped.
3 (lb en of a pipe) Having a stop; being closed at one end.
4 (lb en of a plant) In a well-pruned state.
5 (lb en phonetics) Made by complete closure of the organs in the mouth; said of certain consonants such as ''b'', ''d'', ''p'', and ''t''.
